desc: Derive the geometric visibility criterion: a later building is visible iff its top-line slope from the observer is strictly greater than every earlier top-line slope.
Derive the exact pairwise threshold formula and an \(O(N\log N)\) convex-hull algorithm for its maximum, including strict tangency boundary handling.
Prove the zero-height and equality cases, including when the output is exactly `-1` versus `0`.
Update numeric formatting to at least 18 decimal places and validate the implementation against all samples.
Validate the convex-hull implementation against an \(O(N^2)\) brute-force computation on small random instances.
